title: Flatness descends from the completion to the original local homomorphism
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma is one half of a criterion for flatness of a local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings in terms of its completion, and the proof is a 25-line argument that reduces the general statement to a criterion on quotients of powers of the maximal ideal. Assuming the completed map flat, it shows first that the completion itself is flat over the base, then that the quotient of the completion by the powers of the maximal ideal is flat over the corresponding quotient of the base, and finally applies the local flatness criterion for a ring and an ideal to conclude flatness of the original map. The two reductions are attributed to named statements and displayed, and the final criterion is the only input taken from outside the section.
